key_insight: A DVAE plus particle filter can learn and track latent weld-pool states robustly across different arc welding processes without process-specific tuning.
engineering_relevance: This offers a scalable path to real-time weld monitoring that can tolerate arc radiation, reflections, and other time-varying disturbances in production settings.
method: CNN encoder-decoder learns compact latent features from weld-pool images
LSTM transition model captures latent state evolution under control inputs
Particle filter propagates latent and hidden states for noise-robust inference
evidence_signal: The framework was validated on GTAW and GMAW and showed generalizable, robust monitoring without process-specific tuning.
watch_item: Performance may depend on reliable image capture and PF configuration, and the approach still needs careful integration for real-time shop-floor deployment.
paper_title: Robust Monitoring of Arc Welding Processes: A Generalizable Framework with DVAE and Particle Filter
